uncited: This family addresses the limitations of standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) when applied to dynamic scenes, non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging, and real-world captures with optical artifacts.

**Rendering with Dynamics:** The rendering process integrates time-dependent attributes.
For Gaussian-based methods, position and rotation are computed for the specific time $t$ of the camera ray before rasterization [S2].
